intersection.headline: Nike's investor day: 'Full Stride Ahead' plan targets $5bn extra revenue by 2031, with growth not back until fiscal 2029
intersection.summary: At its first investor day since 2017, Nike set out a strategy built on performance sport (running, training, football, basketball, outdoor) and a reset of Sportswear, with Caitlin Clark on stage. Nike says it expects Jordan Brand to return to growth in fiscal 2029 and Converse in 2028. About $4bn of the planned $5bn in new revenue is expected from performance sports. Jordan is also expected to announce football teams, federations and athletes. Analysts saw the plan as more transparent but late.

fashion.headline: Travis Scott's 'GTA 6' x Nike Air Force 1 collection gets release dates
fashion.summary: With Grand Theft Auto VI days from launch, Nike SNKRS releases the 'Triple White' and 'Triple Black' Air Force 1 Lows on 21 November. A second release follows via Travis Scott's Cactus Jack site on 23 November. An apparel range accompanies the shoes. A gradient-leather friends-and-family pair is limited to Cactus Jack's site.

fashion.headline: Bain: luxury goods sales set to return to growth in 2026, but outlook fragile
fashion.summary: Bain & Company's annual luxury outlook expects personal luxury sales to rise about 2% to €367bn this year, after two years of decline. Jewellery is outperforming while fashion is under pressure. Spending by top-tier customers is offsetting weakness among aspirational shoppers. Bain forecasts 0–4% growth for 2027. It says brands rooted in local identity are gaining interest, particularly in China.
